summary_1line: Parasara teaches Janaka that detachment, knowledge, righteous action, and control of the mind lead to liberation beyond the cycle of birth and death.

image_candidates.scene_text: The soul, like a cloud drifting through the sky after leaving a body, wanders until it finds a new form to inhabit.
Death, imagined as a serpent devouring the air, moves through a world of days and nights consuming all living beings.
A fisherman lifts his submerged boat with a rope, symbolizing the mind raising the soul from the ocean of worldly existence through yoga.
